source: Beginner short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: أنا اسمي سامي وعندي عيلة كبيرة.
sentences.en: My name is Sami and I have a big family.

sentences.ar: أبوي بشتغل بالسوق وإمي بتطبخ أحلى أكل.
sentences.en: My dad works at the market and my mom cooks the best food.

sentences.ar: عندي أخ وأخت، وهمة أصغر مني.
sentences.en: I have a brother and a sister, and they're younger than me.
My grandmother lives with us in the house.

sentences.ar: كل مسا بنقعد سوا ونحكي كتير.
sentences.en: Every evening we sit together and talk a lot.
I love my family a lot.
